description: CDN traffic statistics for the account or one pull zone: total bandwidth, origin traffic, requests served, cache hit rate and average origin response time, plus optional charts (bandwidth, requests, origin traffic, response times, 3xx/4xx/5xx errors, geographic distribution). bunny.net: GET /statistics.

date_from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

date_to.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

load_origin_response_times.description: Include the origin response time chart.

pull_zone_id.description: Only this pull zone. Omit for the whole account.

name: bunny_get_statistics
title: Get CDN statistics
